series.name: Housing Register
series.label: Housing Register
series.note: Applications on the Housing Register. An application represents a household, not all housing need.

series.name: Median Rent Price
series.label: Median weekly rent
series.note: A snapshot of the source rent measure. Dollar values are kept separate from the source's rank rows.

series.name: Building Consents per 10k population
series.label: Building consents
series.note: New dwelling consents over the source reporting period. Consents indicate intended building, not completions.

series.name: Households whose rent is equal to or more than 30% of income
series.label: Rent at least 30% of income
series.note: Census-based rent-to-income measure. Read the source population definition; this is not a monthly estimate. Stored fractions use percentage display: 0.426 = 42.6%.

series.name: Rent affordability index
series.label: Rent affordability index
series.note: An index of change over time. Cross-area values are not an affordability league table. Direction is left neutral.
